text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fumbling when it matters most is just like me,
I suppose... but it still hurts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... Such positive words! I certainly gave it my absolute best. No regrets here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna work super-duper hard
in training so I can take 1st place next time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'm not satisfied with finishing in a place like this either!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely take 1st place!
Just you wait, everyone who's cheering for me!
